_note: R66 building interiors (UI only, never in saves). Tap a building (map or List 'Inside') and the roof lifts off to show every placed furnishing, fitting, bought upgrade and tier. 12 room families; colours, grid sizes and the family of each building are invented (R66 [INV]). art: optional webp per room/piece/upgrade, filled in as Art Studio delivers (room batch list); anything missing draws its emoji.

manor._note: R72: manor suite = display-only tabs. route: item id -> room (anything unnamed, or routed to a locked room, shows in the Great Hall). over[type] overrides per manor type. unlock: a locked room opens when the family owns one of its listed items that routes there. Nothing is saved.

hint.study: Needs a Study Desk, Rune Desk, Alchemist's Bench or a Study Corner / Carved Bookcase
hint.workshop: Needs a Workbench, Loom, Tool Rack, Tanning Rack, Rope Walk or Runestone Anvil
hint.nursery: Needs the Nursery fitting or a Cradle
hint.cellar: Needs a Root Cellar, Larder, Cold Cellar or Dwarven Cask

_noteR67: R67: art.rooms = room background per family (256x192 lossless); art.rects = floor/backwall/door/blocked areas from room1b rects.json; art.pieces = piece id -> art/rooms/<file>.webp. Merged ids (featherbed, minionbunk, cradle -> bed, coldcellar -> larder) are INVENTED mappings for old saves. Classic emoji mode ignores all art.
_noteR68: R68: wall layer. art.onWall pieces hang in art.wallSlots slots on the backwall rect (x wallX, y = backwall bottom+1-25, min 0); copies = one sprite + xN; past 7 distinct ids -> floor. Order built-ins, upgrades (art.upPieces, upgrade name -> piece, INVENTED mapping), furnishings. art.starters = display-only starter kit per building type (no stats, no save); art.beside = starter placed right of a rect; art.tints = CSS tint class. bigWall: walls >= minH tall (mine, kitchen) draw wall pieces at scale and spread evenly (INVENTED). Classic emoji ignores all of it.
_noteR68_1: R68.1: built-ins = building structure at fixed spots (may take floor; furniture routes around). art.attach: upgrade name -> host fixture + side (l/r/t); drawn ON the host (emoji placeholder until art.attachArt has a drawing). Mapping INVENTED.
_noteR68_2: R68.2 painted built-ins (display only, INVENTED boxes measured on the art): art.painted[type].fix = fixtures painted into the room background at pixel boxes [x0,y0,x1,y1]; no sprite is drawn for them, a hit area is, upgrades attach to the box, and floor/wall layout avoids the boxes (plus decor). room = alternate background for that type (smithy -> guildhall interior from Art batch1 workshop-interior). onto = pieces/fittings drawn as add-ons on a painted fixture instead of their own sprite.
_noteR69: R69: mill background replaced by Art room-mill-b (lossless 256x192). art.paintedFam[family] = painted fixtures shared by every building type on that room background (mill: hopper, millstones [id millwheel], drive shaft, flour bin, grain sacks; sawmill/tannery show the same generic machinery, INVENTED). General room-rect zone fields for painted rooms (all optional, default to floor/backwall): floor_large [x0,y0,x1,y1] = only area for floor furniture/storage; wall_strip = only area for wall pieces and the 32px wall slots (y = wall_strip[3]+1-25); paths = named walk areas (service-aisle, door-approach) kept clear; workspots = {fixture:[x,y]} where a worker stands (data for later worker movement, not used yet); anchors = {art id:[x0,y0,x1,y1]} exact spot for an attach add-on (attachArt maps the upgrade to its art id). Display only, nothing saved.
_noteR70: R70 (bunkhouse from rooms-batch-a-c, boxes.json of the repaint): the bunkhouse's two starter bunks are the two painted bunks (painted.starterAs), bought bunks are floor sprites on floor_large; hearth and trestle table are painted in. R70: barracks, chickencoop, cowpen, kitchen (building only), sawmill and tannery have their own painted rooms (art.painted[type].room; a type with its own room does NOT inherit art.paintedFam, so the sawmill/tannery no longer show the mill fixtures). The brewery, smokehouse, preservery and saltworks keep room-kitchen; hall, fort, hunterscabin, advlodge and thievesden keep room-lodge; the gristmill keeps room-mill. Rects carry the boxes.json zones (floor_large, wall_strip, paths, workspots keyed by painted fixture id, anchors keyed by the boxes.json anchor name). upAnchors = {upgrade name: anchor name} pins an add-on at its exact anchor box (no add-on art exists yet, so they are emoji placeholders). painted.as = {piece id: painted fixture id} merges a piece into a fixture (kitchen hearth piece -> the painted hearth). Display only, nothing saved.
_noteR71: R71: art.upPlaceholder = {upgrade: emoji} (Twin Blades, Steam Saw, Scraping Frames, plus Armory so it differs from Drill Ground) replaces the generic upKeys icon for add-ons without art, in the painted room scene and its chips only (Classic keeps upKeys). rects.<room>.spotFlush starts the floor_large spot search on the zone's top-left (96px zone = 3 columns). rects.kitchenhearth.wallPx = 23: the 47px wall_strip holds 2 wall slots of 23px (art's own wall piece size is 24px, 1 slot). painted.<type>.attach = per-type {upgrade: {host, side}} that overrides art.attach for that painted room, and the upgrade is then not also a wall piece: barracks Armory -> weaponrack2 at rack_upgrade, kitchen Spice Shelf -> larder at larder_upgrade. Still unmapped (no obvious host): chickencoop grain_bin_upgrade, cowpen stall_lower_upgrade, kitchen table_upgrade (Great Kitchen?), bunkhouse bedding/hearth/table anchors (bunkhouse has no upgrades), Good Pasture, Great Kitchen, Master Tanner. Display only, nothing saved.
_noteR72: R72: 32 buildings get their own painted rooms (batches C D E F G H I) + a 11-room manor suite at 320x224 (art.manor tabs, display only) + 33 add-on overlays + 10 furniture sprites + art.chipIcons (exact upgrade name -> emoji, ahead of upKeys; Classic keeps upKeys) + rc.pins (tier-fixed pieces pinned to painted slot boxes) + rc.bedFar (beds fill the far end of floor_large). Display only: sim and save (55) unchanged.
